import numpy as np, time
exec(open('builder.py').read())
iscls = np.load('ffn_in_L0_iscls.npy'); seq = np.cumsum(iscls)-1
te = seq%4==3; tr=~te
def obs_select(H, W2, m, lam_rel):
    n, F = H.shape
    Ha = np.c_[H, np.ones(n)]
    G = Ha.T@Ha
    lam = lam_rel*np.trace(G[:F,:F])/F
    G[np.arange(F),np.arange(F)] += lam
    Hinv = np.linalg.inv(G)
    Wc = np.c_[W2, np.zeros(W2.shape[0])].astype(np.float64)  # 768 x F+1
    alive = np.ones(F+1, bool)
    for step in range(F-m):
        d = np.diag(Hinv)
        cost = (Wc**2).sum(0)/d
        cost[~alive] = np.inf; cost[F] = np.inf
        i = np.argmin(cost)
        Wc -= np.outer(Wc[:,i], Hinv[i,:]/Hinv[i,i])
        Hinv -= np.outer(Hinv[:,i], Hinv[i,:])/Hinv[i,i]
        alive[i]=False; Wc[:,i]=0; Hinv[i,:]=0; Hinv[:,i]=0; Hinv[i,i]=1
    keep = np.where(alive[:F])[0]
    return keep, Wc[:,keep], Wc[:,F]   # new W2 cols, bias delta
def test_obs(L, m, lam_rel):
    pre = f"roberta.encoder.layer.{L}."
    W1 = base(pre+"intermediate.dense.weight"); b1 = base(pre+"intermediate.dense.bias")
    W2 = base(pre+"output.dense.weight").astype(np.float64)
    A = ffn_data(L).astype(np.float64); H = gelu(A@W1.T+b1); Y = H@W2.T; Z = A+Y
    t=time.time()
    keep, Wk, db = obs_select(H[tr], W2, m, lam_rel)
    pred = H[:,keep]@Wk.T + db
    err = Y-pred
    den = np.sqrt(((Z[te]-Z[te].mean(0))**2).sum(1)).mean()
    return np.sqrt((err[te]**2).sum(1)).mean()/den, np.sqrt((err[tr]**2).sum(1)).mean()/den, time.time()-t
for L in [1,3]:
    for lr in [1.0, 0.3, 0.1]:
        print(L, lr, test_obs(L,1024,lr))
